lessons.title: Exercise 1

Picture: a young man playing a guitar

items.prompt: Picture: two people at the airport (DEPARTURES sign)

items.prompt: Picture: a man relaxing in a chair reading a newspaper

items.prompt: Picture: a family standing together (parents and children)

items.prompt: Picture: a couple eating at a restaurant

vocab.meaning: tổ chức tiệc nướng ngoài trời
dành thời gian cho gia đình
ăn ở ngoài, ăn nhà hàng

tips: Nhìn chi tiết trong tranh (sân bay, nhà hàng, lưới bóng) để chọn cụm từ.
Nhớ collocation: play + môn thể thao (không 'the'), play + the + nhạc cụ.
lessons.reviewNote: Ảnh 1 bị cắt phần trên: có thể còn các tranh khác phía trên 'have a barbecue'. Mô tả tranh 'go shopping' không thấy (tranh bị cắt). Unit/section không hiển thị, suy đoán Unit 1 (1.1 – free time). Bài có thể còn phần nằm ngoài ảnh chụp.

lessons.title: Word order

items.prompt: time / do / start / what / lessons / your / English ?
answer: what time do your English lessons start
items.hint: Câu hỏi Wh-: What time + trợ động từ + chủ ngữ + động từ?

items.prompt: friends / for / your / how / do / cook / you / often ?
answer: how often do you cook for your friends
items.hint: Hỏi tần suất: How often + do + S + V?

items.prompt: family / people / in / how / your / are / many ?
answer: how many people are in your family
items.hint: How many + danh từ số nhiều + are + ...?

items.prompt: your / mother / come / where / from / does ?
answer: where does your mother come from
items.hint: Hỏi quê quán: Where + does + S + come from? (giới từ đứng cuối)

items.prompt: you / sell / did / your / house / why ?
answer: why did you sell your house
items.hint: Quá khứ đơn: Why + did + S + V nguyên mẫu?

items.prompt: do / drink / you / many / how / in / of / day / glasses / water / a ?
answer: how many glasses of water do you drink in a day
items.hint: How many + glasses of + N + do you + V + ...?

items.prompt: classroom / where / is / the ?
items.hint: Câu hỏi với to be: Where + is + the + N?

items.prompt: your / you / last / did / when / best / friend / see ?
answer: when did your best friend see you last
items.hint: When + did + S + V + O + last?

items.prompt: go / shopping / where / did / you ?

grammar.pattern: Wh- word + auxiliary (do/does/did/is/are) + subject + main verb + ...?
examples: what time do your English lessons start
where does your mother come from
why did you sell your house
grammar.note: Trợ động từ luôn đứng trước chủ ngữ; giới từ (from, for) thường đứng cuối câu hỏi.

tips: Tìm từ để hỏi (what/how/where/why/when) trước, sau đó là trợ động từ, rồi chủ ngữ.
Có 'did' thì động từ chính ở dạng nguyên mẫu.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề, số bài, hướng dẫn, activityId và câu 1 (ví dụ). Suy đoán thuộc Unit 1 (question forms). Đáp án giữ đúng chữ thường như trên màn hình. Bài có thể còn phần nằm ngoài ảnh chụp.

lessons.title: Exercise 3

items.prompt: ___? — I'm a student.
items.hint: Hỏi nghề nghiệp, thì hiện tại đơn

items.prompt: ___? — I live with my friend Olga.
items.hint: Hỏi sống cùng ai: Who + do + you + V + giới từ?

items.prompt: ___? — Only two people live in the house, Olga and me.
answer: How many people live with you
items.hint: Hỏi số lượng người: How many + N + V...?

items.prompt: ___? — In our free time we like to go to the cinema or go out with friends.
answer: What do you do in your free time

items.prompt: ___? — We go to the cinema about once a week.
answer: How often do you go to the cinema
items.hint: Câu trả lời là 'once a week' → hỏi tần suất

items.prompt: ___? — I'm studying English because I would like to work in this country.
items.hint: Câu trả lời có 'because' + thì tiếp diễn

items.prompt: ___ – 2A or 3A? — I'm in class 2A, Pre-intermediate.
items.hint: Chọn giữa 2 lựa chọn → dùng Which; giới từ 'in' ở cuối

items.prompt: ___? — I started learning English when I was at school.
answer: When did you start learning English
items.hint: Câu trả lời ở quá khứ → dùng did

grammar.pattern: Wh- + do/does/did/are + S + V?
examples: What do you do?
How often do you go to the cinema?
When did you start learning English?
grammar.note: Chọn trợ động từ theo thì của câu trả lời: hiện tại đơn → do, tiếp diễn → are, quá khứ → did.

tips: Đọc câu trả lời để biết cần hỏi gì (thời gian, số lượng, lý do...).
Nhìn thì của câu trả lời để chọn trợ động từ phù hợp.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy câu 1 (ví dụ), tiêu đề section và hướng dẫn. Unit/section suy đoán Unit 1 (1.1 question forms).

lessons.title: Exercise 4A

items.prompt: ___: stand up and walk around while you talk on the phone. Or go for a quick ten-minute walk outside...
items.hint: Đoạn nói về vận động, tập thể dục

items.hint: Đoạn nói về liên lạc với bạn bè

items.prompt: ___: answer a difficult email, or call to make that dentist's appointment. Do it now, don't wait...
items.hint: Đoạn nói về việc khó cần làm ngay

items.prompt: ___: order a book you want to read, plan a trip to a museum or a night out with friends...
items.hint: Đoạn nói về lên kế hoạch vui trong tương lai

items.prompt: ___: buy someone flowers, carry their bag, tell them they look nice...
items.hint: Đoạn nói về làm điều tốt cho người khác

items.prompt: ___: even when you don't feel happy, always try to smile...

lessons.passage: Six ways to feel happier. 1 Be active: stand up and walk around while you talk on the phone... Doing exercise gives you energy and makes you feel better. 2 Call a friend: arrange to meet someone for lunch or send an email to a friend you haven't seen for a long time... stay in touch with your friends. 3 Do that difficult job: answer a difficult email, or call to make that dentist's appointment... Cross something off your list of 'things to do' to give yourself energy. 4 Plan for some future fun: order a book you want to read, plan a trip to a museum or a night out with friends. If you look forward to doing something fun in the future, it will make you feel happy right now. 5 Do something nice for someone: buy someone flowers, carry their bag, tell them they look nice... 6 Just smile: even when you don't feel happy, always try to smile. Put a smile on your face right now. It will make you feel better. Tick things off the list when you do them. Do you feel happier yet?
tips: Đọc câu đầu của mỗi đoạn để tìm ý chính rồi ghép tiêu đề.
Tìm từ khóa lặp lại giữa tiêu đề và đoạn văn (smile, friend, fun...).
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy hướng dẫn và section; dạng bài (kéo tiêu đề vào đoạn) suy đoán là fill_blank.

lessons.title: Exercise 2A
lessons.instruction: Put the verbs into the correct verb group, regular or irregular.

items.prompt: stop → ?
walk → ?
work → ?
decide → ?
like → ?
ask → ?
study → ?
try → ?
say → ?
know → ?
see → ?
go → ?
spend → ?
meet → ?
fall → ?
get → ?

grammar.point: Past simple: regular vs irregular verbs
grammar.pattern: Regular: V + -ed (walk → walked); Irregular: dạng riêng (go → went)
examples: stop → stopped
study → studied
meet → met
grammar.note: study/try: y → ied; stop: nhân đôi phụ âm cuối.

tips: Nếu không nhớ được dạng quá khứ bằng -ed thì thường là động từ bất quy tắc.

lessons.title: Exercise 6A
lessons.instruction: Listen to the story of Chris and Amy. Number the sentences in the correct order 1–6.

items.prompt: Chris went on holiday with his friends.
items.hint: Sự kiện mở đầu câu chuyện

items.prompt: Chris met Amy in Spain.
They decided to stop writing to each other.
Chris met Amy in London.
They fell in love.
items.hint: Sau khi gặp lại và đi chơi cùng nhau

items.prompt: They got married and had a son.

lessons.passage: When I was eighteen, I went on holiday with a group of mates to Spain. We had a great time. Every day we went sunbathing on the beach and at night we went out dancing. On the last night, I met an American girl called Amy and we got on really well... We promised to write to each other when we got home... after a few months we decided that it was too difficult because we lived in different countries, so we stopped. I started university and forgot about her. Ten years later, I started a new job in London... It was Amy! I recognised her immediately... we were both really shocked to see each other... we started hanging out with each other... It wasn't long until we fell in love! ... I proposed to her and she accepted! We got married soon after and had our son, Jamie.
tips: Nghe các mốc thời gian: When I was eighteen, after a few months, ten years later.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề/số bài; '6A' suy ra vì Ex 6C (ảnh 18) dùng cùng câu chuyện Chris và Amy. Section 1.2 suy ra theo thứ tự.

lessons.passage: When I was eighteen, I went on holiday with a group of mates to Spain. We had a great time. Every day we went sunbathing on the beach and at night we went out dancing. On the last night, I met an American girl called Amy and we got on really well... We promised to write to each other when we got home... after a few months we decided that it was too difficult because we lived in different countries, so we stopped. I started university and forgot about her. Ten years later, I started a new job in London... It was Amy! I recognised her immediately... we were both really shocked to see each other... we started hanging out with each other... It wasn't long until we fell in love! ... I proposed to her and she accepted! We got married soon after and had our son, Jamie.
tips: Chú ý từ để hỏi: When → thời gian, không phải địa điểm.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề, câu 1 và hướng dẫn; '6B' suy ra theo thứ tự (giữa 6A và 6C). Câu 5: 'in London' là nơi gặp lại nhưng đáp án đúng là 'ten years later'.

lessons.title: Linkers: correct the sentences

items.prompt: I didn't like the film so it was scary. → ___
answer: I didn't like the film because it was scary
items.hint: Nguyên nhân → dùng liên từ chỉ lý do

items.prompt: We saw Pompeii but we thought it was wonderful. → ___
answer: We saw Pompeii and we thought it was wonderful
items.hint: Hai ý cùng chiều, không đối lập

items.prompt: She didn't like her job because she decided to leave. → ___
answer: She didn't like her job so she decided to leave

items.prompt: They couldn't get married and her father wouldn't allow it. → ___
answer: They couldn't get married because her father wouldn't allow it

items.prompt: He started taekwondo lessons but he wanted to get fit. → ___
answer: He started taekwondo lessons because he wanted to get fit

answer: I wanted to go to the concert, but I couldn't find a ticket

grammar.pattern: and = thêm ý; but = đối lập; so = kết quả; because = lý do
examples: We saw Pompeii and we thought it was wonderful
She didn't like her job so she decided to leave
I wanted to go to the concert, but I couldn't find a ticket

tips: Hỏi: vế sau là lý do (because), kết quả (so), đối lập (but) hay thêm ý (and)?
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề, số bài, section và hướng dẫn (dạng: thay liên từ in nghiêng sai bằng liên từ đúng). Suy đoán thuộc 1.2 Writing: linkers.

grammar.pattern: Câu 1 + , so / but / and / because + câu 2

lessons.title: Exercise 6B
lessons.instruction: (top cut off) ... 1 Say what you are writing about. 2 Explain what 'fancy-dress Fridays' are. 3 Invite ideas for fancy dress.

modelAnswer.text:
Dear All,

I would like to tell you about our new idea of 'fancy-dress Fridays'. It is a way to have some fun at work and wear something different from a suit and tie. On the last Friday of every month, each department chooses a theme and dresses up accordingly. There is a prize for the best-dressed person.

We would like to hold our first 'fancy-dress Friday' this month on the 27th and would like you to suggest some ideas for themes. Please email me with any suggestions you have by Friday 14th.

Yours sincerely,
Ben Martin.

(97 words)
structures: I would like to tell you about + N
It is a way to + V
On the last Friday of every month, ...
We would like to + V
would like you to + V
Please email me with + N + by + thời hạn
phrases: Dear All,
our new idea of 'fancy-dress Fridays'
wear something different from a suit and tie
each department chooses a theme and dresses up accordingly
There is a prize for the best-dressed person.
suggest some ideas for themes
any suggestions you have
Yours sincerely,
rewriteTips: Đoạn 1: nói rõ mục đích viết (I would like to tell you about...) rồi giải thích ý tưởng là gì.
Đoạn 2: nêu thời gian cụ thể và mời mọi người góp ý, kèm hạn chót (by Friday 14th).
Gửi cho nhiều đồng nghiệp: mở 'Dear All,' và kết 'Yours sincerely,' + họ tên.
Giữ khoảng 80-100 từ, mỗi ý trong đề (1-2-3) một câu hoặc một đoạn ngắn.

grammar.pattern: S + would like + to V / S + would like + sb + to V
examples: I would like to tell you about our new idea.
We would like you to suggest some ideas for themes.

tips: Đọc kỹ 3 ý bắt buộc trong đề và đảm bảo bài viết có đủ cả 3.
Dùng các cụm lịch sự: I would like to..., Please...by...
lessons.reviewNote: Phần đầu đề bài bị cắt (chỉ thấy 3 ý cần viết). Bài viết của học viên để trống; chỉ có bài mẫu (Model answer).

examples: Would you like to come?
I'd love to.

tips: Kế hoạch đã sắp xếp (có thời gian cụ thể) → hiện tại tiếp diễn.
like/want/love đi với 'to + V' trong lời mời.
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 2b bạn chọn 'I take' (sai) → đúng là 'I'm taking'; câu 3c chọn 'We meet' (sai) → đúng là 'We're meeting'. Không thấy tiêu đề/số bài (có lẽ 3.1 Writing: invitations).

lessons.title: Exercise 6A
lessons.instruction: Complete the email invitations using the prompts.

items.prompt: ___ (I / have / party) at my house on Saturday.
items.hint: Hiện tại tiếp diễn cho kế hoạch

items.prompt: ___ (you / want / come)?
items.hint: Câu hỏi hiện tại đơn + to V

items.prompt: ___ (we / go / have / music) and plenty of food.
___ (Julie / get / tickets / go / theatre) next Wednesday.
answer: Julie is getting tickets to go to the theatre

items.prompt: ___ (we / go / see / Shakespeare play) – I can't remember which one.
answer: We're going to see a Shakespeare play

items.prompt: ___ (would / like / come)? The tickets are £17.50.

lessons.passage: Email 1 (Kristoph): I'm having a party at my house on Saturday. Do you want to come? We're going to have music and plenty of food. Bring your friends too. Just let me know. — Email 2 (Becca): Julie is getting tickets to go to the theatre next Wednesday. We're going to see a Shakespeare play – I can't remember which one. Would you like to come? The tickets are £17.50.

modelAnswer.text:
Hi Kristoph,
Good to hear from you. I'm sorry, but I'm out of town this weekend. I'm going to visit my brother and his wife in Edinburgh.
Thanks for the invite anyway. Have a fun party and see you soon!
Liane

Becca,
I'd love to come on Wednesday - that sounds like a great idea. Let me know when you want the money for the ticket. Let's meet for a coffee before the play.
Julian

(75 words)
structures: I'm sorry, but + lý do (từ chối)
I'm going to + V (dự định)
I'd love to + V (nhận lời)
Let me know when + S + V
Let's + V (đề nghị)
that sounds like + a/an + adj + N
phrases: Good to hear from you.
I'm out of town this weekend.
Thanks for the invite anyway.
Have a fun party and see you soon!
I'd love to come on Wednesday
that sounds like a great idea
Let me know when you want the money for the ticket.
Let's meet for a coffee before the play.
rewriteTips: Từ chối: mở đầu thân thiện (Good to hear from you) → xin lỗi + lý do cụ thể (I'm sorry, but...) → cảm ơn (Thanks for the invite anyway) → chúc (Have a fun party).
Nhận lời: I'd love to come... + khen ý tưởng (that sounds like a great idea) + hỏi chi tiết thực tế (tiền vé, giờ) + đề xuất thêm (Let's...).
Dùng hiện tại tiếp diễn / be going to để nói kế hoạch của mình làm lý do.
Giữ thư ngắn (khoảng 35–40 từ mỗi thư), ký tên ở cuối, không cần câu chào trang trọng.

vocab.meaning: đi vắng, không ở thành phố

grammar.pattern: I'm + V-ing / We're going to + V / Would you like to + V? / Do you want to + V?
examples: I'm having a party at my house on Saturday.
We're going to have music.
Would you like to come?

tips: Chú ý viết hoa chữ đầu câu và tên riêng (Julie, Shakespeare) vì bài chấm capitalization.
Thêm từ còn thiếu trong gợi ý: mạo từ (a), 'to', trợ động từ (Do/are).
lessons.reviewNote: Bài chấm cả viết hoa (capitalization). Ảnh image76 là 'Model answer' (thư trả lời lời mời của Kristoph và Becca) – có lẽ thuộc bài viết tiếp theo (6B: viết thư trả lời) nhưng không thấy đề bài 6B, nên gắn vào đây.

grammar.pattern: Who/What/Which + N + V (không dùng do/does/did)?

vocab.meaning: cờ vua kết hợp quyền anh

grammar.pattern: Chủ ngữ: Who/What/Whose + N + V ; Tân ngữ: Wh- + do/does/did + S + V
examples: Who invented basketball in 1891?
How many hours a month do Canadians spend online?
Whose daughter is called Lisa Marie?
grammar.note: Nếu phần gạch chân là chủ ngữ → không dùng trợ động từ; nếu là tân ngữ/bổ ngữ → cần do/does/did.

tips: Xác định phần gạch chân là chủ ngữ hay không trước khi viết câu hỏi.

lessons.reviewNote: Hướng dẫn và câu 1 (ví dụ) bị cắt; không thấy tiêu đề/số bài (có lẽ mục 3.2). Đáp án là chữ xanh hệ thống hiện ra.

lessons.passage: Most of fiction's great minds belong either to criminals or to the men and women who catch them. The greatest of these is probably Sherlock Holmes. The Holmes stories were written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, a doctor from Edinburgh, Scotland. Conan Doyle knew a lot about the human body and police work, and he used this information in his books. Very quickly, Conan Doyle's hero became popular. When Holmes was killed in one story, thousands of readers protested. Conan Doyle changed his mind, and Holmes appeared in another story.

lessons.reviewNote: Tranh 1 và 2 bị cắt phía trên; vị trí nhãn drop his ticket / pay the taxi driver suy ra theo bố cục. Không có tiêu đề/hướng dẫn.

lessons.sectionTitle: Grammar: past simple and past continuous
lessons.title: Tim Bobo story

items.prompt: as he was going out of the house he ___ on the floor.
items.hint: Hành động ngắn xen vào → QKĐ

items.prompt: He took a taxi to the airport but while he ___, someone took his bag.
He checked in, but while he ___, he found some keys in his pocket.
When it was taking off, he ___ around the plane!
items.hint: Hành động chính xen vào → QKĐ (go bất quy tắc)

items.prompt: Unfortunately, the other passengers ___ and they told him to be quiet.
items.hint: Hành động nền đang diễn ra, chủ ngữ số nhiều

items.prompt: while the plane was landing he ___ his mobile phone!

lessons.passage: This is the story of Tim Bobo's first trip in an aeroplane. He was very excited, but as he was going out of the house he dropped his ticket on the floor. He took a taxi to the airport but while he was paying the taxi driver, someone took his bag...

grammar.point: Past continuous with while/as; past simple for events
grammar.pattern: while/as + S + was/were V-ing, S + V2
examples: while he was paying the taxi driver, someone took his bag
while the plane was landing he decided to use his mobile phone

tips: Sau while/as thường là QKTD; mệnh đề còn lại chứa sự việc chính dùng QKĐ.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề/hướng dẫn; mục 5.1 là suy đoán.

items.prompt: Which map is correct? (question text and maps cut off) Map A / Map B

tips: Đọc lướt để nắm hành trình trước khi chọn bản đồ.
lessons.reviewNote: Chỉ thấy lựa chọn Map A (đúng) / Map B; câu hỏi và bản đồ bị cắt. Có thể thuộc bài đọc về Tobi Gutt. Mục/kỹ năng là suy đoán.

lessons.title: Tobi Gutt - true/false

items.prompt: When he was booking his ticket, he made a mistake.

tips: Câu T/F thường đổi một chi tiết (địa điểm, đồ vật) - so kỹ với bài.
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 (không có trong ảnh); câu 4 bị cắt cuối câu.

lessons.title: Tobi Gutt - complete the summary

items.prompt: A twenty-one-year-old German tourist called Tobi Gutt wanted to visit his girlfriend in Sydney, Australia. Unfortunately, ___.

items.hint: Lỗi khi đặt vé trên mạng

items.prompt: When he looked at the plane to Sidney, he became confused. Strangely, ___.

answer: his parents and friends from Germany sent him some money
items.hint: Ai giúp anh ấy cuối cùng, và gửi gì?

lessons.passage: Story: Tobi Gutt, 21, German tourist, wanted to fly to Sydney, Australia but ended up flying to Sidney (USA).
tips: Đọc cả câu trước và sau chỗ trống để chọn phần kết phù hợp về nghĩa.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy hướng dẫn; dạng bài (chọn/kéo phần kết câu) là suy đoán.

items.prompt: 1 Down (2 words, 10+7 letters)
2 Down (2 words, 7+5 letters)

items.hint: Máy chụp ảnh kỹ thuật số

lessons.reviewNote: Ảnh chỉ có ô chữ đã giải, không thấy gợi ý (clues) hay tiêu đề; số bài 1A suy ra vì ảnh sau là 5.2 Exercise 1B. Đáp án đọc rõ.

lessons.title: Exercise 1B
lessons.instruction: Complete the sentences.

items.prompt: I wrote her phone number in my ___.
items.hint: Viết số điện thoại vào đâu?

These ___ are new and my feet are really hurting.

items.prompt: It's raining. We'll have to wear some ___.
Can you see that beautiful bird? Have a look through the ___.
items.hint: Nhìn xa qua dụng cụ gì?

items.prompt: My passport was in my ___, but I took it off when I went swimming.
items.hint: Đồ đeo quanh người để giữ giấy tờ, tiền

items.prompt: Thirty kilos. I'm afraid your ___ is too heavy. You'll need to pay extra.
items.hint: Hành lý bị cân ở sân bay

items.prompt: I wanted to take some photos, but I left my ___ at home.

lessons.passage: Word bank: binoculars, waterproof clothes, money belt, digital camera, suitcase, sun hat, notebook, walking boots
tips: Tìm từ khóa chức năng: photos → camera, hot → sun hat, raining → waterproof.
lessons.reviewNote: Đáp án câu 2 'souvenirs' không thấy trong hộp từ ở ảnh (có thể hộp từ bị thiếu/cắt).

lessons.title: Verb + -ing / to + infinitive

items.prompt: My brother wants ___ you before he leaves.
We chose ___ married in Venice because that's where we first met.
My parents love ___ time with their grandchildren.
It always seems ___ when I come to stay.
The company decided ___ the money we paid for the tickets.
We should avoid ___ when there is too much traffic.
The builders need ___ their work before we can paint the house.
We hope ___ you again soon.
I must finish ___ this letter.
Just imagine ___ in a place as beautiful as this!
I hate ___ to the supermarket.

grammar.point: Verb patterns: verb + -ing / verb + to + infinitive
grammar.pattern: want/choose/seem/decide/need/hope + to V; love/avoid/finish/imagine/hate + V-ing
examples: My parents love spending time with their grandchildren.
The company decided to refund the money.
We should avoid travelling when there is too much traffic.
grammar.note: Học thuộc theo nhóm động từ.

tips: Xác định động từ đứng trước chỗ trống rồi nhớ xem nó đi với to V hay V-ing.
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 và phần hướng dẫn (động từ gốc trong ngoặc không hiện). Các đáp án 2-12 đều đúng (xanh lá).

lessons.title: Make sentences

items.prompt: I / expect / hear from / travel agent / later today
answer: I expect to hear from the travel agent later today

items.prompt: we / want / go / on holiday, / but / we / too busy
answer: We want to go on holiday, but we're too busy

items.prompt: we / seem / go back / same place / every year
answer: We seem to go back to the same place every year
items.hint: seem + to V; thêm to the

items.prompt: Alan / chose / stay / in hotel
answer: Alan chose to stay in a hotel
items.hint: choose + to V; thêm mạo từ a

items.prompt: we / enjoy / walk / and look at / the beautiful countryside
answer: We enjoy walking and looking at the beautiful countryside

items.prompt: I / decided / travel / on my own
answer: I decided to travel on my own

items.prompt: we / avoid / visit / tourist resorts / in summer
answer: We avoid visiting tourist resorts in summer

items.prompt: we / need / book / our flights / before / prices / go up
answer: We need to book our flights before prices go up
items.hint: need + to V; prices go up (hiện tại đơn)

grammar.pattern: expect/want/seem/choose/decide/need + to V; enjoy/avoid + V-ing
examples: We enjoy walking and looking at the beautiful countryside
We need to book our flights before prices go up

tips: Thêm mạo từ (the, a) và chia động từ theo mẫu; nhớ viết hoa chữ đầu câu.
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 và hướng dẫn. Đáp án 2-9 là đáp án hệ thống (xanh dương), không thấy dấu chấm cuối trong ô đáp án.

lessons.title: Paragraph headings

items.prompt: Paragraph 1 → ?
items.hint: Đoạn nói về việc trước chuyến đi

items.prompt: Paragraph 2 → ?
items.hint: Đoạn nói về xử lý rắc rối

items.prompt: Paragraph 3 → ?
items.hint: Đoạn nói về trải nghiệm khác lạ

items.prompt: Paragraph 4 → ?
items.hint: Đoạn nói về tận hưởng tốt nhất

tips: Đọc câu đầu mỗi đoạn - thường chứa ý chính.
lessons.reviewNote: Bài đọc (không hiển thị) có vẻ là mẹo du lịch; mục 5.2 suy đoán theo thứ tự.

lessons.title: True/false

items.prompt: It's a good idea to take earplugs for when you want to go swimming.
items.hint: Earplugs dùng để làm gì theo bài?

items.prompt: It's best not to worry when you have problems.
items.hint: Lời khuyên khi gặp vấn đề

items.prompt: There aren't many opportunities to do anything different when you travel.
items.hint: Bài có khuyến khích làm điều khác lạ?

items.prompt: Don't buy souvenirs if they're not good.
items.hint: Chú ý ý kiến về đồ lưu niệm

items.prompt: Try to accept things which seem strange to you.

tips: Cẩn thận với câu phủ định (not, aren't) - so sánh ý nghĩa, không chỉ từ khóa.
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1.

lessons.title: Find words in the text

items.prompt: things you put in your ears to keep out noise (paragraph 1): ___
places where you can eat and sleep cheaply for a short time (paragraph 1): ___
items.hint: Nhà nghỉ giá rẻ, số nhiều

items.prompt: able to wait calmly (paragraph 2): ___
a machine where you can get money from your bank (paragraph 2): ___
abilities; things you can do (paragraph 3): ___
items.hint: Danh từ số nhiều: kỹ năng

items.prompt: from the place where you are (paragraph 4): ___

tips: Đề cho sẵn số đoạn - chỉ tìm trong đoạn đó và để ý từ loại (danh từ số nhiều, tính từ).

lessons.title: Put the stories in order

items.prompt: Story 1 - first line: We had a great night out. → next three lines in order?
answer: First, we met in a bar in town. | Then we went out for a pizza. | After the meal, we went dancing.
items.hint: Dùng từ nối thứ tự: First → Then → After ...

items.prompt: Story 2 - first line: The holiday was a disaster. → next four lines in order?
answer: First, the flight was cancelled. | We waited, and after a while we had to fly to a different airport. | Then, our taxi broke down on the way to the hotel. | Finally, when we arrived, the hotel didn't have our reservation.
items.hint: First → after a while → Then → Finally

vocab.meaning: có buổi tối đi chơi vui

grammar.pattern: First, ... Then ... After a while, ... After the meal, ... Finally, ...
examples: First, the flight was cancelled.
Finally, when we arrived, the hotel didn't have our reservation.
grammar.note: Dấu phẩy sau First/Finally ở đầu câu.

tips: Tìm các từ nối (First, Then, after a while, Finally) để xác định thứ tự; câu Finally luôn ở cuối.
lessons.reviewNote: Hộp câu phía trên bị cắt; thứ tự đáp án đọc rõ. Câu After the meal... học viên làm đúng, các câu khác là đáp án hệ thống.

lessons.title: Writing task - model answer (journey story)
lessons.passage: Model answer (100 words).

modelAnswer.text: We had a lovely holiday in the Scilly Isles last year and we went there by ferry. First, we drove to the ferry terminal in Penzance. We parked our car in their car park and then walked to the terminal building. It was very busy, but after a while we got on the ferry. It was a good journey and the sea was calm and flat. When we arrived at our destination of St Mary's, we took a taxi to our hotel. We checked in and took our cases to our room. Finally, we went out for something to eat.
structures: First, + S + V2 ...
S + V2 ... and then + V2 ...
It was very busy, but after a while + S + V2
When + S + V2, S + V2 ...
Finally, + S + V2 ...
go there by + phương tiện (by ferry)
phrases: We had a lovely holiday in ...
we went there by ferry
drove to the ferry terminal
parked our car in their car park
after a while we got on the ferry
the sea was calm and flat
When we arrived at our destination
took a taxi to our hotel
We checked in
went out for something to eat
rewriteTips: Mở bài bằng 1 câu giới thiệu chuyến đi: ở đâu, khi nào, đi bằng phương tiện gì.
Kể lần lượt các bước bằng từ nối First, then, after a while, When..., Finally.
Dùng thì quá khứ đơn cho chuỗi hành động; nhớ động từ bất quy tắc (drove, got, took, went).
Thêm 1 câu nhận xét (It was a good journey...) để bài sinh động; độ dài khoảng 100 từ.

grammar.point: Past simple + sequencers for a journey story
grammar.pattern: First, ... then ... after a while ... When ..., ... Finally, ...
examples: First, we drove to the ferry terminal in Penzance.
Finally, we went out for something to eat.

tips: Viết theo trình tự thời gian, mỗi câu một bước của hành trình.
lessons.reviewNote: Đề bài viết không hiển thị trong ảnh (chỉ thấy phần Model answer). Có thể thuộc 5.2 Writing (sequencers) - cần kiểm tra lại số mục/bài. Bài có thể còn phần nằm ngoài ảnh chụp.

lessons.title: Exercise 1
lessons.instruction: Complete the sentences.

items.prompt: There were a lot of ___.
I always wanted to be a tour ___.
answer: guide because I love showing people my city

items.prompt: We went on a guided ___.
answer: tour around the churches of Rome
items.hint: guided + ... (chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn)

items.prompt: They saw a lot of tourist attractions, including ___.
answer: the History Museum and the National Art Gallery

items.prompt: I really enjoyed the boat trip ___.
The best thing about Corsica is the scenery, which ___.
Our boat took us under a ___.
answer: waterfall, which was probably fifty metres high

lessons.passage: Bank: tourists in our hotel / down the River Nile / tour around the churches of Rome / includes mountains, beaches and forests / waterfall, which was probably fifty metres high / the History Museum and the National Art Gallery / guide because I love showing people my city

vocab.meaning: chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn

tips: Nhìn từ đứng ngay trước chỗ trống (tour, guided, a) để ghép thành cụm từ du lịch.

lessons.title: Prepositions in directions

items.prompt: For the police station, go straight ___ and you can't miss it.
Go ___ the main road until you see the sports field.
To reach the train station, you need to go ___ the centre of town.
Keep going ___ until you reach the corner of King's Road.
items.hint: Keep going không cần giới từ

items.hint: Giới từ chỉ vị trí ở góc phố

items.prompt: Walk for two minutes and you'll see the school in front ___ you.
Take ___ the second left after the library and you'll see my house.
items.hint: Take the second left - không cần giới từ

items.prompt: For the post office, go ___ the turning for the station.
items.hint: Đi qua, vượt quá chỗ rẽ

vocab.meaning: bạn không thể bỏ lỡ đâu (rất dễ thấy)

grammar.pattern: go straight on / go along / go through / go past / at the corner / in front of / take the second left
examples: Go along the main road until you see the sports field.
You'll find the bar at the corner.
grammar.note: Keep going và Take the ... left không cần giới từ.

tips: Có ô không cần giới từ (–): kiểm tra cụm cố định như keep going, take the second left.
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 5: học viên chọn 'of' (sai), đáp án đúng là 'at'. Dạng bài (gõ hay chọn) không chắc vì có lựa chọn '(–)'.

lessons.title: Places on a map

items.prompt: Place 1 → ?
Place 2 → ?
Place 3 → ?
Place 4 → ?
Place 5 → ?
Place 6 → ?

lessons.passage: Bank (cut): ... university h(all) ...
tips: Nghe chỉ đường và theo dõi trên bản đồ từng bước (turn left, go past...).
lessons.reviewNote: Chỉ thấy danh sách đáp án 1-6; bản đồ, hướng dẫn và câu hỏi bị cắt. Dạng bài và kỹ năng (listening) là suy đoán.

lessons.title: Order the words

items.prompt: A: Excuse me. ___? (help / you / me / can) I'm looking for the Science Museum.
items.hint: Câu hỏi nhờ giúp: Can + you + V + me

items.prompt: B: Go straight on. ___. (can't / you / it / miss)
A: OK, so it's easy! ___? (map / you / the / me / on / can / show)
answer: Can you show me on the map
items.hint: Can you show me + on the map

items.prompt: A: Excuse me. I'm trying to find the internet café. ___? (the / this / way / right / is)
B: Yes. Keep going. ___. (it / see / of / front / in / you / you'll)
answer: You'll see it in front of you
items.hint: You'll see it + in front of you

items.prompt: A: ___? (walk / I / can)
B: Yes, you can. ___. (about / minutes / it / ten / takes)
A: ___ to the tube? (far / it / is)
A: OK. ___? (to / need / left / so / the / go / at / I / cinema)
answer: So I need to go left at the cinema
items.hint: So + I need to go left + at the cinema

vocab.meaning: Dễ thấy lắm, không lạc được

grammar.pattern: Can you help me? / Is this the right way? / Is it far to...? / It takes about + time / You can't miss it
examples: Can you show me on the map?

You'll see it in front of you.

tips: Câu hỏi bắt đầu bằng trợ động từ (Can/Is); câu trả lời bắt đầu bằng chủ ngữ.
Để ý dấu ? hay . sau chỗ trống để biết là câu hỏi hay câu trần thuật.

lessons.title: Complete the introduction

items.prompt: I've ___ a lot of time living in different countries

tips: Đọc cả câu để nhận ra thì (I've lived, I'm asking) và cụm cố định (think of ... as).

lessons.title: Match quotes to speakers

items.prompt: I suppose plane journeys are not always the most exciting of things. → ?

necessity → ?

lessons.title: Complete what the speakers say

lessons.title: Exercise 1
lessons.instruction: Complete the text with the words in the box.

items.prompt: I try to eat healthily. I buy lots of ___ fruit and vegetables and use these to cook with.
I don't like to eat ___ food like hamburgers or packets of crisps …
items.hint: Đồ ăn nhanh, không tốt cho sức khoẻ (___ food).

items.hint: Bia, rượu đều là loại đồ uống này.

items.prompt: I work in the city and spend a lot of time ___ about my work.
items.hint: spend time + V-ing; 'lo lắng về' = ___ about.

items.prompt: I don't have much time, but I make sure I get enough ___ from fruit and vegetables.
items.hint: Chất có nhiều trong trái cây, rau (số nhiều).

items.prompt: I wish I could spend more time ___ at home with my family.
items.hint: spend time + V-ing; nghỉ ngơi, thư giãn.

items.prompt: Sometimes I don't eat all day. I'm addicted to ___ though!
items.hint: Chất trong cà phê (câu sau nói uống 10 cốc cà phê).

items.prompt: I drink about ten cups of coffee a day and have lots of ___ drinks, too.
What's really important to me is keeping fit. I go to ___ classes twice a week …
… and at the weekend I go ___.
items.hint: go + V-ing (môn thể thao): go swimming, go ___.

lessons.passage: Hộp từ: fresh · running · junk · vitamins · caffeine · alcohol · fizzy · worrying · exercise · relaxing

vocab.example: I buy lots of fresh fruit and vegetables.

vocab.meaning: đồ ăn vặt / đồ ăn nhanh không lành mạnh
vocab.example: I don't like to eat junk food like hamburgers.
I spend a lot of time worrying about my work.
I get enough vitamins from fruit and vegetables.
I wish I could spend more time relaxing.
I have lots of fizzy drinks.
What's really important to me is keeping fit.
At the weekend I go running.

grammar.pattern: spend (a lot of / more) time + V-ing
examples: I spend a lot of time worrying about my work.
I wish I could spend more time relaxing.
grammar.note: Sau spend time luôn dùng V-ing.

grammar.pattern: go + V-ing
examples: I go running at the weekend.
grammar.note: go swimming, go shopping, go running…

tips: Đọc cả câu và xem từ đứng sau chỗ trống: ___ food, ___ drinks, ___ classes là cụm cố định.
Sau spend time / go cần V-ing: chỉ chọn các từ đuôi -ing trong hộp.

lessons.title: Present perfect conversations

items.prompt: A: How long ___ here? (Carlos / work)
B: About four years. He ___ here for four years. (be)
A: Did you see that comedy film last night? B: Yes, it was the funniest film I ___! (ever / watch)
items.hint: so sánh nhất + I have ever + V3

items.prompt: A: Do you know where Morris ___? (go) B: No. I (…) him all day. (not / see)
items.hint: has gone = đã đi (chưa về); phủ định HTHT (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: A: Do you know where Morris (…)? (go) B: No. I ___ him all day. (not / see)
items.hint: has gone = đã đi (chưa về); phủ định HTHT (ô 2/2)

items.prompt: A: ___ your homework? (you / finish) B: No. I (…) it yet. (not / start)
items.hint: Câu hỏi HTHT; yet với phủ định (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: A: (…) your homework? (you / finish) B: No. I ___ it yet. (not / start)
items.hint: Câu hỏi HTHT; yet với phủ định (ô 2/2)

items.prompt: A: Do you know if my parcel ___? (arrive) B: Just a minute. I'll have a look for you.
items.hint: Chủ ngữ số ít: has + V3

items.prompt: A: ___ your watch? (you / find) B: Yes, it was under the sofa.
A: How long ___ Marissa? (you / know) B: Not very long. We (…) friends for long at all. (not / be)
items.hint: How long + have you + V3; know-knew-known (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: A: How long (…) Marissa? (you / know) B: Not very long. We ___ friends for long at all. (not / be)
items.hint: How long + have you + V3; know-knew-known (ô 2/2)

items.prompt: A: ___ my news? (you / hear) B: No. (…) to leave your job? (you / decide)
items.hint: Câu hỏi HTHT: Have you + V3 (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: A: (…) my news? (you / hear) B: No. ___ to leave your job? (you / decide)
items.hint: Câu hỏi HTHT: Have you + V3 (ô 2/2)

grammar.point: Present perfect (experience, unfinished time, recent news)
grammar.pattern: have/has + V3; Have/Has + S + V3?; How long have/has + S + V3?
examples: How long has Carlos worked here?
it was the funniest film I've ever watched
No. I haven't started it yet.
grammar.note: Dùng for + khoảng thời gian; ever sau so sánh nhất; yet trong phủ định/câu hỏi.

tips: Chú ý động từ bất quy tắc: be-been, go-gone, see-seen, find-found, know-known, hear-heard.
Chủ ngữ ngôi 3 số ít dùng has, rút gọn là 's.
lessons.reviewNote: Không có tiêu đề; mục 6.1 suy đoán.

lessons.title: Sentences with for/since

items.prompt: (prompt cut off) he / work / for that company / six months
answer: He's worked for that company for six months

items.prompt: we / live / Turkey / 2013
items.hint: since + mốc thời gian; live in

items.prompt: I / not be / to the cinema / a long time
answer: I haven't been to the cinema for a long time

items.prompt: they / be here / two months now
answer: They've been here for two months now

items.prompt: I / not clean / the house / last Monday
answer: I haven't cleaned the house since last Monday

items.prompt: she / not listen to / that music / she was a teenager
answer: She hasn't listened to that music since she was a teenager

items.prompt: we / not hear / from him / he left
answer: We haven't heard from him since he left

items.prompt: Bob / be a builder / more than forty years
answer: Bob has been a builder for more than forty years

items.prompt: the phone / not ring / 10 o'clock
answer: The phone hasn't rung since 10 o'clock

items.prompt: I / want / to climb a mountain / I was a child
answer: I've wanted to climb a mountain since I was a child

grammar.pattern: S + have/has (not) + V3 + for + period / since + point in time (or past clause)
examples: We've lived in Turkey since 2013
They've been here for two months now
We haven't heard from him since he left

tips: for + khoảng thời gian (two months, a long time); since + mốc (2013, last Monday, 10 o'clock, he left).
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 và phần gợi ý của câu 2 (bị cắt, chỉ thấy đáp án). Gợi ý câu 2 trong prompt là tái dựng từ đáp án.

lessons.sectionTitle: Grammar: present perfect vs past simple
lessons.title: Interview with Joy

items.prompt: Interviewer: Why ___ it?
items.hint: Hỏi về thời điểm quá khứ (2012) → QKĐ

items.prompt: What ___ to do?
I ___ Laugh to Live because I (…) I had something I wanted to share with people.
I (…) Laugh to Live because I ___ I had something I wanted to share with people.
In my life I ___ and worked in four different countries, in four different continents, so
so ___ a lot of experience and (…) with people from all over the world.
so (…) a lot of experience and ___ with people from all over the world.
Years ago, when I ___ to Africa, I (…) poor children in the jungle who had nothing.
Years ago, when I (…) to Africa, I ___ poor children in the jungle who had nothing.
But they had the biggest smiles ___.
items.hint: So sánh nhất + have ever + V3

items.prompt: I have a few techniques which I ___ to help people learn to laugh more often
And because they now laugh more, they ___ happier people.
items.hint: Kết quả ở hiện tại → HTHT

lessons.passage: Interview with Joy, who started the Laugh to Live organisation in 2012.

grammar.pattern: Finished time (years ago, in 2012, when...) → V2; life experience / result now → have/has + V3
examples: Years ago, when I travelled to Africa, I met poor children...
I've had a lot of experience
they have become happier people
grammar.note: Có mốc thời gian quá khứ cụ thể thì không dùng HTHT.

tips: Tìm dấu hiệu thời gian: years ago, when, in 2012 → quá khứ đơn; ever, in my life, now → hiện tại hoàn thành.
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 6: học viên viết 'have travelled' (sai), đáp án đúng 'travelled' (có Years ago). Mục 6.1 suy đoán.

lessons.title: Predictions: will, may, might

items.prompt: A: Will that café on Wardour Street be open tomorrow? B: I don't know. It ___ be.
A: I've cooked little Johnny some vegetables for tonight's dinner. B: Thanks, but he ___ eat them.
A: Can I try your food? B: Be careful. It ___ be too hot for you.
A: Do we need to buy any ingredients for this recipe? B: Maybe. We ___ have enough garlic. Can you check?
A: You know Melissa's a vegetarian, don't you? B: OK, I ___ cook meat.
A: Are you going to that new bar before you leave town? B: I don't know. I hope so, but we ___ have time.
A: What are your predictions for food in the future? B: The good news is I think it ___ be more healthy.
items.hint: I think + ... (dự đoán chắc chắn hơn)

grammar.point: will / won't / may / might (not) for predictions
grammar.pattern: S + will/won't + V (chắc chắn); S + may/might (not) + V (có thể)
examples: I don't know. It might be.
he won't eat them
I think it will be more healthy.
grammar.note: Dấu hiệu: I don't know / Maybe → may/might; I think / chắc chắn → will/won't.

tips: Tìm từ chỉ mức độ chắc chắn: I don't know, Maybe → might/may; I think → will.
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 và hướng dẫn/lựa chọn. Câu 2, 3, 5 là đáp án hệ thống (xanh dương); câu 4, 6, 7, 8 học viên làm đúng. Theo tài liệu thuộc 6.2.

lessons.title: Order the words: food predictions

items.prompt: eat / We / in / future / animals / won't / the
answer: We won't eat animals in the future
items.hint: S + won't + V + O + in the future

items.prompt: organic / eat / more / food / may / We
answer: We may eat more organic food
items.hint: S + may + V + more + adj + N

items.prompt: might / Junk / become / illegal / food
the / West / fatter / People / in / will / get
answer: People in the West will get fatter
items.hint: S + will + get + so sánh hơn

items.prompt: left / sea / the / not / in / be / may / fish / There / any
answer: There may not be any fish left in the sea
items.hint: There + may not + be + any + N + left

grammar.pattern: S + will/won't/may/might (not) + V
examples: There may not be any fish left in the sea
Junk food might become illegal
grammar.note: may/might + not + be: not đứng sau modal.

tips: Chữ viết hoa trong các từ cho biết từ đứng đầu câu (We, Junk, People, There).
lessons.reviewNote: Thiếu câu 1 và hướng dẫn; theo tài liệu thuộc 6.2.

lessons.title: Exercise 5B

items.prompt: Why did Wansink do the experiments? (To improve the food we eat. / To discover why people eat more than they need.)
answer: To discover why people eat more than they need.
items.hint: Mục đích của thí nghiệm: tìm hiểu hành vi ăn uống

items.prompt: How did Wansink do his experiments? (He asked questions about what people ate. / He gave free food to people and then watched them.)
answer: He gave free food to people and then watched them.
items.hint: Ông ấy quan sát chứ không phỏng vấn

items.prompt: Who ate more? (The people who thought their food was expensive. / The people who thought their food was cheap.)
answer: The people who thought their food was expensive.
items.hint: Liên quan đến giá tiền người ăn nghĩ về món ăn

items.prompt: What was interesting about the popcorn experiment? (The popcorn didn't taste good. / The popcorn had different colours.)
items.hint: Điều bất ngờ nằm ở hương vị bỏng ngô

items.prompt: Who ate more chicken? (The people with messy tables. / The people with clean tables.)
items.hint: Bàn có dọn xương gà hay không

items.prompt: Who ate more sweets? (The people whose sweets had seven colours. / The people whose sweets had ten colours.)
answer: The people whose sweets had ten colours.
items.hint: Nhiều màu hơn → ăn nhiều hơn?

lessons.passage: Bài đọc về các thí nghiệm ăn uống của Brian Wansink (popcorn, chicken, sweets).
tips: Đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch chân từ khóa (who, how, why) rồi tìm đoạn tương ứng trong bài.
Hai lựa chọn thường trái ngược nhau (expensive/cheap, messy/clean) – tìm chi tiết chính xác trong bài.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề/URL trong ảnh; mã 6.2 Ex 5B lấy theo tiêu đề trong tài liệu Word.

lessons.title: Bài chưa rõ số (Điền từ)

items.prompt: giving your attention to something → ___
many different types of things → ___
scientific tests to find information → ___
items.hint: Danh từ số nhiều: thí nghiệm khoa học

items.prompt: based on a calculation of what most people do → ___
items.hint: Cụm giới từ: tính trung bình

tips: Xác định loại từ của định nghĩa (danh từ/động từ/cụm từ) để chọn từ trong hộp phù hợp.
lessons.reviewNote: Ảnh không có tiêu đề/số bài; đoán là bài từ vựng của phần 6.2 Reading (từ trong bài Wansink). Hộp từ bị cắt, có thể còn câu phía dưới.

lessons.title: Bài chưa rõ số (Nhập từ)

items.prompt: I have always liked cooking. I cook every day.
answer: I have always liked cooking and I cook every day
items.hint: Nối hai ý bổ sung cho nhau

items.prompt: I was very young. I cooked my first meal.
answer: I was very young when I cooked my first meal
items.hint: Nối hai ý bằng từ chỉ thời gian

items.prompt: I don't eat much meat. I eat a lot of fish.
answer: I don't eat much meat but I eat a lot of fish

items.prompt: I was working as a chef in a horrible hotel. I decided to open my own restaurant.
answer: I was working as a chef in a horrible hotel when I decided to open my own restaurant
items.hint: Hành động đang diễn ra thì một hành động khác xảy ra

items.prompt: I don't drink alcohol. I use a little wine in some of the dishes I prepare.
answer: I don't drink alcohol but I use a little wine in some of the dishes I prepare

items.prompt: I like meeting customers at my restaurant. I ask them about the food.
answer: I like meeting customers at my restaurant and I ask them about the food

grammar.pattern: Clause 1 + and/but/when + clause 2
examples: I don't eat much meat but I eat a lot of fish
I was very young when I cooked my first meal
grammar.note: and = thêm ý; but = đối lập; when = thời điểm.

tips: Chấm dứt câu 1 bằng dấu chấm → bỏ dấu chấm, thêm từ nối, viết thường chữ đầu câu 2 (trừ I).
Chú ý chấm điểm có tính viết hoa/viết thường.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề và yêu cầu (bị che bởi hộp lưu ý viết hoa). Có thể là 6.2 Writing Ex 6A (nối câu bằng and/but/when) vì ngay sau là Ex 6B.

lessons.title: Exercise 6B
lessons.instruction: Rewrite the sentences with the words and and also in the correct place in the sentences.

items.prompt: My favourite types of food are pasta fresh fish. I like fruit.
answer: My favourite types of food are pasta and fresh fish. I also like fruit
items.hint: and nối hai danh từ; also đứng trước động từ thường

items.prompt: Every morning I buy vegetables herbs from the market. I buy meat there.
answer: Every morning I buy vegetables and herbs from the market. I also buy meat there
items.hint: also đứng giữa chủ ngữ và động từ thường

It's also cheaper

grammar.pattern: A and B

fresher and better quality

lessons.title: Bài chưa rõ số (Nhập từ)

items.prompt: He ___ (never / travel) abroad.

grammar.pattern: have/has + V3 (ever/never/yet/so far) vs V2 (yesterday/in 1956/last night)
examples: He has never travelled abroad.
My grandparents came to this country in 1956.

grammar.note: Có thời gian cụ thể trong quá khứ → quá khứ đơn.

tips: Tìm dấu hiệu thời gian: yesterday/ago/last/in + năm → quá khứ đơn; ever/never/yet/so far → hiện tại hoàn thành.

lessons.title: Exercise 2
lessons.instruction: Select the correct options to complete the text.

items.prompt: To enter the university library everyone ___ show a current student or staff ID.
To borrow books, you ___ take the books to the front desk and show your ID.
You ___ take out a maximum of eight books.
There are some books that you ___ take out. These are marked Reference Only.
There is a late fee of 20p per day, but you ___ renew the books online for an extra week.
items.hint: Có thể – khả năng được phép

items.prompt: If you have renewed the books before the due date, you ___ pay the fee.
To order books that are not in the library, you ___ fill in the form at the front desk, marked Special Orders.
You ___ write the full name of the book, the author and the ISBN.
We ___ guarantee a date for the arrival of these books.
You ___ write in the books; anyone who is caught doing this will pay a fine.

grammar.point: can / can't / have to / don't have to / must / mustn't
grammar.pattern: modal + V (nguyên mẫu)
examples: You can take out a maximum of eight books.
You don't have to pay the fee.
You mustn't write in the books.
grammar.note: don't have to = không cần; mustn't = cấm.

tips: Phân biệt don't have to (không cần) và mustn't (cấm) – hay bị nhầm.
Đọc câu sau để hiểu ngữ cảnh (ví dụ 'anyone who is caught… will pay a fine' → mustn't).
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 3 và 5 học viên chọn sai (can't, don't have to); đáp án đúng là 'can' (chữ xanh). Bài Review 2 được xếp vào Unit 6 (ôn tập sau Unit 6).

lessons.title: Bài chưa rõ số (Tích ô)

items.prompt: They've been waiting here … (since the office opened. / for hours. / since ten minutes.) – choose the wrong option

lessons.title: Exercise 1
lessons.instruction: Select the correct alternative to complete the sentences.

tips: Học động từ đi kèm giới từ theo cụm: wait for, look for, dream about, think about, move to.
lessons.reviewNote: Phần bên phải câu 1, 3, 4 bị cắt; có thể còn câu sau câu 4 không có trong ảnh.

grammar.pattern: S + used to + V; S + didn't use to + V; Did + S + use to + V?

grammar.note: Phủ định/câu hỏi dùng 'use to' (không có d).

lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy tiêu đề/yêu cầu và danh sách động từ; phần phải câu bị cắt. Có thể 7.1 Grammar.

lessons.title: Bài chưa rõ số (Nhập từ)

answer: They used to sit in traffic on the way to the office

answer: James didn't use to spend his time sitting on the beach

answer: They didn't use to eat tropical fruit for breakfast

items.prompt: they / not wear / shorts and a T-shirt to work

grammar.pattern: S + used to / didn't use to + V
examples: They used to sit in traffic on the way to the office
They didn't use to eat tropical fruit for breakfast

tips: 'not' trong gợi ý → didn't use to.
Thêm giới từ cần thiết (dream about).
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 1 (ví dụ) không có trong ảnh. Không thấy tiêu đề. Câu 4 đáp án hệ thống là 'Harry used to wear a suit to go to work' (có thêm 'go').

grammar.point: Purpose and reason: to / because / so
grammar.pattern: to + V (mục đích); because + S + V (lý do); so + S + V (kết quả)
examples: He drove for six hours to meet you
I spent time abroad because I like travelling
The bus was late so we walked
grammar.note: Không dùng 'for + V-ing' hoặc 'for + V' để chỉ mục đích.

tips: Chỉ mục đích dùng to + V, không dùng for.
because of + danh từ; because + mệnh đề.

…so Rebecca copied her.

vocab.meaning: theo đuổi thiết kế đồ họa

She's moved to a different part of London.

lessons.title: Exercise 3
lessons.instruction: Click on the correct alternatives.

items.prompt: That's the woman who / where works in the supermarket.
Hamburg is the city who / where Lidia went to university.
Is that the cake that / who you made for Claire's birthday?
Did you take the money where / that was on the table?
items.hint: Tiền là vật, không phải nơi chốn

items.prompt: The hotel where / which we stayed on holiday was terrible.
items.hint: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề đầy đủ (we stayed) → nơi chốn

items.prompt: Have you seen that video of the man which / who can eat metal?
Did you get the message who / which I sent you last night?
Helen is the only person I know where / that hates pizza.
items.hint: person = người, loại bỏ từ chỉ nơi chốn

items.prompt: That's the bar which / where Tina met Dan.
items.hint: Tina met Dan ở đó → nơi chốn

items.prompt: I don't like films which / who make me cry.

grammar.point: Defining relative clauses: who / which / that / where
grammar.pattern: người + who/that; vật + which/that; nơi chốn + where + S + V
examples: That's the woman who works in the supermarket.
I don't like films which make me cry.
That's the bar where Tina met Dan.
grammar.note: that dùng được cho cả người và vật; where thay cho 'in/at which' và theo sau là mệnh đề có chủ ngữ riêng.

tips: Xác định danh từ đứng trước: người → who, vật → which, nơi → where; 'that' thay cho who/which.
Nếu sau chỗ trống thiếu chủ ngữ (…who works) thì không dùng where.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy mã phần; nhiều khả năng là 8.1 Grammar: relative clauses.

lessons.title: Join sentences with relative clauses

items.prompt: Callin is a private university. I studied physics there. → Callin is the private university ___.
Renata Samuels is a dentist. She fixed my teeth. → Renata Samuels is the dentist ___.
La Cosecha is a bar. You get free food there. → La Cosecha is a bar ___.
Did you get my note? I left it on your table. → Did you get the note ___?
answer: that I left on your table

items.prompt: Mannix Music is a shop. It sells old CDs. → Mannix Music is the shop ___.
Did you find the keys? I gave them to your girlfriend. → Did you find the keys ___?
answer: which I gave to your girlfriend

items.prompt: David Bynes is a personal trainer. He helped me get fit. → David Bynes is the personal trainer ___.
Konstanz is a town. I was born there. → Konstanz is the town ___.

vocab.example: David Bynes is the personal trainer who helped me get fit.

grammar.pattern: N + who/that + V... ; N + which/that + S + V (bỏ it/them) ; N + where + S + V (bỏ there)
examples: Renata Samuels is the dentist who fixed my teeth.
Did you find the keys which I gave to your girlfriend?
Konstanz is the town where I was born.
grammar.note: Không lặp lại đại từ (she/it/them/there) trong mệnh đề quan hệ. Ảnh 4 (that) và 6 (which) cho thấy cả hai đều chấp nhận cho vật.

tips: Tìm từ ở câu 2 lặp lại danh từ câu 1 (she, it, them, there) rồi thay bằng who/which/that/where.
Nhớ bỏ đại từ bị thay để tránh lỗi 'the note that I left it'.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy số bài và câu lệnh. Đáp án hiển thị một phương án; có thể hệ thống chấp nhận that/which thay nhau.

lessons.title: Correct the relative clause mistakes

items.prompt: It's a place which you can really relax.
answer: It's a place where you can really relax
items.hint: Nơi chốn + S + V → đại từ nào?

items.prompt: Do you still see your friend who she became a motorcycle courier?
answer: Do you still see your friend who became a motorcycle courier

items.prompt: Clarissa started a company that it sells organic food.
answer: Clarissa started a company that sells organic food

items.prompt: The book is about a girl who finds a magic forest.
That's the house that I was born.
answer: That's the house where I was born

items.prompt: I don't like people which talk all the time.
answer: I don't like people who talk all the time

items.prompt: What's the name of the cake that we ate yesterday?
items.hint: cake = vật, ate cần tân ngữ

items.prompt: Is this the iPod that you want it?
answer: Is this the iPod that you want

vocab.meaning: người giao hàng bằng xe máy
vocab.example: your friend who became a motorcycle courier
a company that sells organic food

grammar.pattern: Không lặp đại từ: N + who/that + V (không 'who she'); N + that + S + V (không '... want it')
examples: Do you still see your friend who became a motorcycle courier?
That's the house where I was born.
Is this the iPod that you want?
grammar.note: where dùng khi mệnh đề phía sau đã đủ thành phần (I was born, you can relax).

tips: Soát 3 lỗi hay gặp: sai who/which, thừa đại từ (she/it), dùng that/which thay cho where.
Nếu câu đúng, gõ 'correct'.
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 1 không có trong ảnh; câu lệnh không hiển thị. Bài có thể còn phần nằm ngoài ảnh chụp.

lessons.title: Reading: famous people and money (multiple choice)

items.prompt: (question not visible) sports / music / food / films
items.hint: Đọc lại bài: các lĩnh vực nào được nhắc tới (bóng đá, phim, âm nhạc)?

tips: Với câu hỏi chọn chủ đề, gạch chân các lĩnh vực mỗi đoạn nhắc tới rồi loại trừ.
Đọc kỹ câu hỏi có 'NOT' hay không trước khi chọn.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy nội dung câu hỏi. Người học chọn 'sports' (đỏ, sai); 'food' in đậm đen với nút chọn = đáp án đúng do hệ thống đưa ra (giống kiểu hiển thị ở ảnh 275). Có thể câu hỏi là 'lĩnh vực nào KHÔNG được nhắc tới' - cần xem lại.

a short or friendly name that is used by friends or family (paragraph 1)
boxing matches (paragraph 2)

lessons.title: Multi-word verbs in stories

items.prompt: Rick: It's a huge dog which took ___ too much space in our small flat.
When we came back, he had turned the living room ___ a war zone!
items.hint: turn A ... B = biến A thành B

items.prompt: When my neighbour returned, we couldn't wait to give him ___.
Lena: We started a club for people who wanted to give ___ smoking.
I invited my friend, but after a few weeks, he took ___ the club.

lessons.passage: Rick: My wife offered to look after our neighbour's dog... Lena: We started a club for people who wanted to give up smoking... Now we watch films seven days a week - we hardly speak to each other! We're all addicted.

vocab.example: It's a huge dog which took up too much space.

people who wanted to give up smoking

tips: Học động từ nhiều từ theo cụm kèm ví dụ, vì tiểu từ thay đổi hẳn nghĩa.
give up + V-ing: bỏ làm việc gì.
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 3: người học điền 'round' (sai), đáp án đúng là 'up'. Không thấy câu lệnh; có thể phía trên còn đoạn văn khác bị cắt. Kiểu bài (gõ hay kéo) là suy đoán.

lessons.title: Complete the multi-word verbs

items.prompt: I played squash for twenty years until I gave it ___ last year.
The boss offered Julia a promotion, but she turned it ___ because she wanted to spend m... [cut] family.
When are you going to give ___ that book you borrowed from me?
This desk takes ___ too much space.
We expected things to change after we took ___ the company.

vocab.example: The boss offered Julia a promotion.

grammar.pattern: verb + it/them + particle
examples: I gave it up.
She turned it down.
grammar.note: Với đại từ (it/them), đại từ phải đứng giữa động từ và tiểu từ.

tips: Hộp từ có hai lần 'up' → có hai chỗ trống dùng up.
Đọc đến cuối câu để hiểu ngữ cảnh (because she wanted... → từ chối).
lessons.reviewNote: Câu 2 bị cắt bên phải sau chữ 'spend m...' (không ảnh hưởng đáp án).

lessons.title: Adverbs of degree in an advert

items.prompt: The guitar is in ___ good condition. (very)
items.hint: Trạng từ đứng trước tính từ

items.prompt: It sounds ___ good. (really)
The guitar is ___ easy to play. (fairly)
It will be ___ difficult to find a better offer than this! (extremely)

vocab.example: The guitar is in very good condition.
The guitar is fairly easy to play.
It will be extremely difficult to find a better offer.

vocab.meaning: lời chào hàng, giá ưu đãi

grammar.pattern: very / really / fairly / extremely + adj
examples: It sounds really good.
The guitar is fairly easy to play.
It will be extremely difficult to find a better offer than this!
grammar.note: fairly (khá) < very/really (rất) < extremely (cực kỳ).

tips: Trạng từ mức độ luôn đứng ngay trước tính từ mà nó bổ nghĩa.
Dùng các trạng từ này để viết quảng cáo bán đồ hấp dẫn hơn.
lessons.reviewNote: Từ cần dùng đã cho trong ngoặc, bài yêu cầu đặt vào đúng vị trí; kiểu tương tác (gõ/kéo) chưa rõ. Không thấy câu lệnh và số bài.

lessons.title: Write an advert (model answer)
lessons.passage: Pictures: a laptop, a bicycle and a digital camera (things to sell).

modelAnswer.text:
Cyber Pixelmix digital camera: €40
• This small and stylish 16 megapixel digital camera is in very good condition.
• It looks really good and takes beautiful photos.
• It has a 5x optical zoom and can take videos too.
• It's fairly easy to use and comes with a useful little instruction booklet.
• It will be extremely difficult to find a better offer than this!
structures: Tên món đồ + giá: Cyber Pixelmix digital camera: €40
S + is in + very/good condition
It looks + adv + adj (It looks really good)
It has + tính năng + and can + V ... too
It's + fairly/very + adj + to V (It's fairly easy to use)
It will be extremely difficult to find a better offer than this!
phrases: small and stylish
in very good condition
takes beautiful photos
comes with a useful little instruction booklet
It will be extremely difficult to find a better offer than this!
rewriteTips: Mở đầu bằng tên món đồ và giá, sau đó viết 4-5 gạch đầu dòng ngắn.
Mỗi gạch đầu dòng nói một ý: tình trạng, vẻ ngoài, tính năng, độ dễ dùng, phụ kiện kèm theo.
Dùng trạng từ mức độ (very, really, fairly, extremely) trước tính từ để quảng cáo hấp dẫn hơn.
Kết thúc bằng câu thuyết phục người mua (a better offer than this!).

vocab.example: comes with a useful little instruction booklet

grammar.pattern: very/really/fairly/extremely + adj
examples: It looks really good.
It's fairly easy to use.

tips: Viết câu ngắn, rõ ràng; ưu tiên tính từ tích cực.
Luôn nêu giá và tình trạng món đồ.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy đề bài (bị cắt phía trên, chỉ thấy hình laptop, xe đạp, máy ảnh). Có thể là 'write an advert for something you want to sell'. Bài mẫu chép đúng từ ảnh và từ văn bản trong tài liệu. Bài có thể còn phần nằm ngoài ảnh chụp.

lessons.sectionTitle: Grammar: too much / too many / enough
lessons.title: too / enough / very - who is it?

items.prompt: She eats too ___ junk food. ___
She doesn't do ___ exercise. (…)
She doesn't do (…) exercise. ___
She does too ___ exercise. (…)
She does too (…) exercise. ___
She doesn't sleep ___. (…)
She doesn't sleep (…). ___
She sleeps ___ much. (…)
She sleeps (…) much. ___
She is ___ unhealthy. (…)
items.hint: Trạng từ mức độ trước tính từ, không mang nghĩa 'quá mức' (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: She is (…) unhealthy. ___
items.hint: Trạng từ mức độ trước tính từ, không mang nghĩa 'quá mức' (ô 2/2)

items.prompt: She works too ___ hours a week. (…)
She works too (…) hours a week. ___
She watches too ___ TV. (…)
items.hint: TV (thời lượng xem) không đếm được (ô 1/2)

items.prompt: She watches too (…) TV. ___
items.hint: TV (thời lượng xem) không đếm được (ô 2/2)

items.prompt: She eats ___ different types of vegetables. (…)
She eats (…) different types of vegetables. ___
She spends ___ much money on food. (…)
She spends (…) much money on food. ___

vocab.meaning: đồ ăn vặt không lành mạnh
vocab.example: She eats too much junk food.

grammar.point: too much / too many / (not) enough / very
grammar.pattern: too much + N không đếm được; too many + N đếm được số nhiều; (not) enough + N / V + enough; too + adj/adv
examples: She eats too much junk food.
She works too many hours a week.
She doesn't sleep enough.
grammar.note: very = rất (trung tính); too = quá (mang nghĩa tiêu cực, nhiều hơn mức cần).

tips: Xác định danh từ đếm được hay không để chọn much/many.
enough đứng trước danh từ nhưng sau động từ/tính từ.
Tên người (Melanie/Sandra/Doris) lấy từ bài đọc/nghe mô tả thói quen của từng người.
lessons.reviewNote: Mỗi câu có 2 chỗ: từ cần điền và tên người (Melanie/Sandra/Doris) - bài đọc/nghe về 3 người không có trong ảnh. Kiểu nhập (gõ hay chọn) chưa rõ.

lessons.sectionTitle: Grammar: too much / too many / enough
lessons.title: Match sentence beginnings and endings

items.prompt: There isn't enough food here; → ?
answer: we need to buy some more.

items.prompt: There's too much food here; → ?
answer: we won't need all of it.

items.prompt: He's too good at tennis → ?
answer: for us – the game will be boring if he plays.
items.hint: too + adj + for sb: quá ... đối với ai (tiêu cực)

items.prompt: He's very good at tennis → ?
answer: and I love watching him play.

items.prompt: There are too many → ?
items.hint: Cần danh từ đếm được số nhiều

items.prompt: There's too much → ?
items.hint: Cần danh từ không đếm được

items.prompt: This film is too → ?
In this film there is too → ?
items.hint: too + much + N không đếm được

items.prompt: We don't have much time to catch the bus, → ?
answer: so we have to be quick.
items.hint: Ít thời gian nhưng vẫn kịp → phải nhanh

items.prompt: We don't have enough time to catch the bus, → ?
items.hint: Không đủ thời gian → phải đổi cách đi

items.prompt: The homework was very difficult → ?
items.hint: very difficult: khó nhưng vẫn làm được

items.prompt: The homework was too difficult → ?
items.hint: too difficult: khó đến mức không làm được

items.prompt: Oh no! I've been out in the sun too long → ?
items.hint: Hậu quả của việc quá lâu

items.prompt: I've had enough sun → ?
I spent too much → ?
answer: time relaxing, so I failed my course.
items.hint: too much + N không đếm được (time)

items.prompt: I spent too many → ?
answer: days away from my work, so I lost my job.

vocab.example: In this film there is too much violence.
I've been out in the sun too long and I'm burnt now.
I spent too much time relaxing, so I failed my course.

grammar.point: very vs too; too much/many; (not) enough
grammar.pattern: very + adj (vẫn làm được) ; too + adj (không làm được / tiêu cực) ; too much + N không đếm được ; too many + N đếm được
examples: The homework was very difficult but I finished it.
The homework was too difficult so I didn't finish it.
There are too many cars on the roads.

tips: Phân biệt very (khó nhưng làm được) với too (quá mức, dẫn đến kết quả xấu).
Khi vế đầu kết thúc bằng 'too much/too many' thì vế sau phải bắt đầu bằng danh từ phù hợp.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy câu lệnh; kiểu bài có thể là kéo thả vế sau. Câu 12 xuất hiện ở cả 2 ảnh (chỉ ghi 1 lần).

lessons.title: Exercise 6B
lessons.instruction: Listen to the story. Then find and select five mistakes in the summary below.

items.prompt: Maggie and Joe Smith lived in the same house for fifteen years. (select the wrong word)
items.hint: Chú ý con số năm trong bài nghe

items.prompt: A few years later, Maggie heard someone say that Jones had found some money in her old house. (select the wrong word)

items.hint: Tiền được tìm thấy ở đâu trong nhà?

In the end, the judge decided that Mr Jones should get all of the money. (select the wrong word)
items.hint: Ai được nhận tiền cuối cùng?

lessons.passage: Maggie and Joe Smith lived in the same house for fifteen years. When Joe died, Maggie sold the house to David Jones. A few years later, Maggie heard someone say that Jones had found some money in her old house. Jones told her there was $10,000 in the wall. He offered her $5,000. She agreed. A few days later, Jones asked Maggie to sign a contract that said she should accept $5,000 for any money found in the garden. She didn't sign it. Instead, she took Jones to court. In court, he told the truth: there wasn't $10,000. There was $15,000. Joe Smith, Maggie's husband, was putting money in the wall for fifty years and he never told his wife. In the end, the judge decided that Mr Jones should get all of the money.

vocab.example: Jones asked Maggie to sign a contract.
In court, he told the truth.

tips: Đọc tóm tắt trước, gạch chân số liệu, thời gian, địa điểm, tên người - lỗi thường nằm ở đó.
Khi nghe, so sánh từng chi tiết với tóm tắt.
lessons.reviewNote: Đáp án là từ SAI cần chọn (màu xanh); màn hình không cho biết thông tin đúng thay thế là gì.

lessons.title: Vague language in shops

vocab.meaning: mấy thứ, đồ (khi không biết tên)

that stuff for taking paint off walls

grammar.point: Vague language for things you don't know the name of
grammar.pattern: one of those things (you use to + V) ; that stuff for + V-ing ; a type of / a kind of + N
examples: I'm looking for one of those things you use to open cans.
Do you have any of that stuff for taking paint off walls?
It's a type of pasta.
grammar.note: things: đồ vật đếm được; stuff: chất/vật không đếm được.

tips: Xem từ đứng sau chỗ trống: 'of pasta' → chỉ cần 'a type'; 'journalist' → cần 'a kind of'.
those + số nhiều (things); that + không đếm được (stuff).

lessons.title: Types of shops

items.prompt: chain stores → ?
answer: They sell the same things and have the same name.

items.prompt: stores → ?

items.prompt: second-hand shops → ?

lessons.title: Exercise 1B
lessons.instruction: Now do the quiz!

items.prompt: The world's largest ocean is the ___.
The Gobi Desert is in ___. (Australia / Asia)
items.hint: Nằm giữa Mông Cổ và Trung Quốc

items.prompt: The mountain range where you can find Mount Everest is called the ___. (Andes / Himalayas)
The second longest river in the world is the ___. (Amazon / Nile)
At over 1,700 m deep, the deepest lake in the world is ___. (Baikal / Victoria)
The highest waterfall in the world is ___. (Niagara Falls / Angel Falls)

grammar.pattern: the + adj-est / the most + adj + N + in the world
examples: The world's largest ocean is the Pacific.
The highest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls.

tips: Đây là kiến thức chung; ghi nhớ các đáp án như sự thật địa lý.

lessons.title: Compare France and Poland

items.prompt: The population of France is ___ the population of Poland. (big)
items.hint: So sánh hơn tính từ ngắn, gấp đôi phụ âm

items.prompt: Poland is ___ France. (small)
Mont Blanc, in France, is ___ Rysy in Poland. (high)
In January, it is ___ than in France. (cold)
items.hint: So sánh hơn + nơi chốn (nước nào lạnh hơn?)

items.prompt: In July, it is ___ than in Poland. (hot)
items.hint: Gấp đôi phụ âm cuối + nơi chốn

vocab.example: The population of France is bigger than the population of Poland.

grammar.pattern: adj + -er + than (big → bigger, hot → hotter)
examples: Poland is smaller than France.
In January, it is colder in Poland than in France.
In July, it is hotter in France than in Poland.
grammar.note: Tính từ 1 âm tiết kết thúc bằng phụ âm-nguyên âm-phụ âm thì gấp đôi phụ âm cuối.

tips: Câu 4-5 phải thêm cả tên nước vào sau tính từ (colder in Poland).
Nhớ quy tắc gấp đôi phụ âm: big → bigger, hot → hotter.
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy câu lệnh và số bài; có thể thuộc 9.1 Grammar.

items.prompt: In the winter, the days are ___ (short).

vocab.example: the most popular tourist destination in the country

grammar.pattern: adj-er / more + adj + than ; the + adj-est / the most + adj (+ in/of ...)
examples: The weather is getting worse.
It's the most popular tourist destination in the country.

grammar.note: Bất quy tắc: good → better → the best; bad → worse → the worst. y → i: happy → happiest.

tips: Dấu hiệu so sánh hơn: than, much, getting.
Dấu hiệu so sánh nhất: in the country/world, of my life, I've ever...
lessons.reviewNote: Không thấy câu lệnh và số bài. Câu 10 xuất hiện ở cả hai ảnh (ghi 1 lần).

lessons.title: Exercise 8
lessons.instruction: Select the correct alternatives to complete the text.

items.prompt: How often do you use ___ car?

And it keeps me fit too. If I want to go to the sea for the weekend, or something like that, then I usually get the bus or the train. I don't think people should spend so much time in their cars. lessons.title: Grammar: certainty/uncertainty — correct the mistakes

items.prompt: Maybe that's a glacier in the photo. (write 'correct' or rewrite)
items.hint: Kiểm tra vị trí của "maybe" trong câu.

items.prompt: The waterfall don't can be here – it's too dry.
answer: The waterfall can't be here - it's too dry
items.hint: Phủ định của động từ khuyết thiếu không dùng do/don't.

items.prompt: That bird can't be an eagle – it's too small. (write 'correct' or rewrite)
items.hint: can't be = chắc chắn không phải.

items.prompt: Perhaps that the people scared all the animals away.
answer: Perhaps the people scared all the animals away
items.hint: Sau "Perhaps" không cần thêm liên từ.

items.prompt: The mountain range in the picture could to be the Himalayas.
answer: The mountain range in the picture could be the Himalayas
items.hint: Sau động từ khuyết thiếu dùng V nguyên mẫu không "to".

items.prompt: Those might be a bear's footprints on the ground. (write 'correct' or rewrite)
That's definitely no a mosquito bite – it's too big.
answer: That's definitely not a mosquito bite - it's too big
items.hint: Phủ định của "be" dùng "not", không dùng "no" trước "a".

grammar.point: Certainty and uncertainty (might, could, can't, perhaps, maybe, definitely)
grammar.pattern: S + might/could/can't + V (bare infinitive); Perhaps/Maybe + clause; S + be + definitely (not) + noun
examples: The waterfall can't be here.
The mountain range could be the Himalayas.
That's definitely not a mosquito bite.
grammar.note: Modal verbs không đi với do/don't và không có "to" phía sau.

tips: Tìm lỗi thường gặp: "to" sau modal, "don't" với modal, "that" thừa sau perhaps.
Nếu câu đúng, viết "correct".
